result.title: From AI Infrastructure to the 6G Future
result.description:
In this Telecom Special Address from NVIDIA GTC Berlin, Ronnie Vasishta, SVP of Telecom at NVIDIA, explores how AI-RAN, accelerated computing, and AI inference at the edge are shaping the path to 6G.

Key Highlights: 
- Understand how AI factories, distributed inference, AI-RAN, and 6G fit into one strategic roadmap for telcos.
- Learn about the latest breakthroughs and ecosystem advancements in AI Infrastructure, edge AI, and 6G.
- Discover what this advancement means for your business, from a commercialization and monetization perspective.

Chapters:
00:00 Telecom Infrastructure’s Role in AI
08:27 Deutsche Telekom’s Distributed Cloud and AI-RAN Pilot
09:43 Edge AI Robotics with Agile Robots
11:29 Orange’s Real-Time AI Translation Pilot with Nemotron
13:46 European Telco AI Factories and AI Services
15:04 AI-RAN: Moving to Software-Defined Radio Access Networks
17:24 NVIDIA Aerial RAN Computers: MGX Systems and DGX Spark
20:58 Elisa Demo: Running AI and RAN on Shared Infrastructure
22:27 BT’s Planned AI-RAN Trials and T-Mobile’s Commercial Call
25:25 Open 6G Research with NVIDIA Sionna and Aerial
30:40 Nemotron Models for Telecom Network Operations
33:04 Cisco and Nokia: AI Agents for Network Troubleshooting
34:21 Nokia and NVIDIA’s AI-RAN Partnership

result.description:
